trial: First two weekly digests free to anyone who replies; no card, no obligation.

products.name: Weekly Bid Digest
products.description: Every Monday, a PDF/HTML digest of open federal solicitations, pre-solicitations and sources-sought notices on SAM.gov matching one trade's NAICS codes, your set-aside certifications and your home state plus neighboring states: title, agency, due date, place of performance, set-aside and the SAM.gov notice link, with recent comparable awards from USAspending for each.

products.name: Weekly Bid Digest Plus
products.description: The weekly digest for up to 3 trades (any NAICS list) and any set of states or nationwide, plus a mid-week alert for notices that close within 7 days.

products.name: Incumbent and price history report
products.description: One-time report for a single solicitation you are pricing: every USAspending award in the same NAICS at the same location over 5 years, with awardee, amount, agency and dates.
